item.title: Bexley Council Men Dumped This sofa etc whilst cleaning rubbish from the Alley way nearby, 9th August
item.description:
The Bexley Council Workmen men dumped this sofa and a bag on Friday 7th of August at lunch time obstructing 3 homes driveway on the pavement. No consideration that of the weekend. Kids have been playing with it during g the night. If this is for collection why leave it in front homes using the drop kerb get in out of their homes. It could have been left in alleyway where there is space and council men could have been informed to collect it from that point. It is very annoying and inconsiderate of council men to work in a very unprofessional manner, without due care attention. I am writing this on behalf of 48,50 and 52 Dale Road. It is giving us stress. Please attend to this first in the 9th of August Monday morning early possible. If it is still there by Monday evening I will writing to the local MP of conduct of these Bexley council workers.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dale Road, Crayford, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
